name: gpt-audio-plugin
description: Generate music with ACE-Step/MiniMax routing and listen to attached audio for grounded music analysis through GPTAudioMCP.

interface.shortDescription: Generate routed music or analyze attached audio.
interface.longDescription: GPTAudioMCP 0.7.1 routes new instrumental generation to ACE-Step 1.5 and vocal generation to MiniMax Music 2.6 by default, while keeping cover/reference/continuation routes explicit. It also sends actual attached or saved audio to a multimodal listening model for grounded critique and analysis through your connected Replicate account.
defaultPrompt: Generate music from our current conversation.
Listen to the audio file I attached and critique the arrangement, instrumentation, structure, mood, and production.
Use the audio file I attached and our conversation as the creative direction.
